papers.title: A brief overview of cellular and molecular mechanisms of osseointegration
papers.abstract: Osteointegration is one of the most studied issues and is considered as one of the most evaluated cases in implantology. It is important for implantologists to have an in-depth understanding of what exist in the bone-implant interface. It is a treatment plan that is compatible with standards and provides a better clinical forecast. The present study is a comprehensive review from all that have been conducted regarding various aspects of osteointegration.
